scope: Hand-constructed synthetic serving fixture; local and undeployed; no real model or data evaluation

source_identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF-to-LF normalization

ranking.volume_unit: Items traded in a daily observation; serving uses completed daily observations, not the four-hour forecast or five-minute source interval
ranking.tie_break: Score descending, then item ID ascending
ranking.current_time: Source interval completed, source age within limit, forecast target still in the future; upstream validity also required
ranking.selection: Eligible rows are ordered before top-k and before attaching outcome labels; missing labels do not trigger backfill
ranking.baseline: Spread ordering on the same model-eligible universe; conditional comparison, not an independent test of the gates

fixture.presentation: Probability and volatility are raw fixture inputs. Served scores follow serve_items: item 4 retains a finite score but fails rank eligibility; time/liquidity gates clear scores for items 5 and 6. Other served prediction fields on gated rows are withheld.

independent_coordinator.scope: 31 synthetic ranking checks and 14 serving-validity checks

limits: Baseline compares ordering conditional on model eligibility, not independent gate value
Hashes and complete cohort declarations are consistency checks, not proof of prospective provenance
No performance acceptance threshold or inferential confidence interval
Synthetic outcome scores intentionally omitted; fixture explains selection, not profitability or predictive quality.
No real evaluation, fitting, model deserialization, prospective collection, public deployment or new compatible model.
Historical results and dated evidence remain unchanged.
